section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Theft Deterrent System
title: THEFT DETERRENT SYSTEM

content.description: Complete wiring diagram for the theft deterrent system showing connections between ignition switch, dome fuse, CIG fuse, HAZ fuse, taillight relay, headlight relay, theft deterrent horn, headlight retainer relay, door lock control switches, door lock solenoids, door key unlock switches, back door courtesy switch, and back door key unlock switch. The diagram includes multiple diodes, ground connections, and battery connections. The system shows both left-hand (LH) and right-hand (RH) door circuits with parallel solenoid configurations.
